title: SourceIndexService
responsibility: Indexes revision-bound source, imports, declarations, storage syntax and execution facts, resolving component props and caching parsed blobs with bounded reads.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.constructor.tree
inputs.description: Readable source snapshot used to resolve prop declarations without importing application code.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.constructor.files
inputs.description: Indexed source files and references available in this same revision.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.path
inputs.description: Source path containing the component prop declaration to resolve.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.owner
inputs.description: Component name prefixed to each resolved prop field.

inputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs.seen
inputs.description: Already visited type references for recursion protection; defaults to a new empty Set.

inputs.name: resolveComponentProps.tree
inputs.description: Readable snapshot supplying the indexed component and imported prop-type source.

inputs.name: resolveComponentProps.files
inputs.description: Indexed file map whose component prop signatures are enriched in place.

inputs.name: SourceIndexService.index.tree
inputs.description: Snapshot with list and read operations; source read failures reject indexing.

inputs.name: SourceIndexService.index.config
inputs.description: Workspace, classification, ignore and declared-reference rules for this index.

inputs.name: importedBinding.file
inputs.description: Parsed TypeScript source containing import and re-export bindings.

inputs.name: importedBinding.name
inputs.description: Local or exported binding name to resolve to its original name and module specifier.

inputs.name: selectedProps.items
inputs.description: Resolved prop fields to transform without executing component code.

inputs.name: selectedProps.operator
inputs.description: Partial, Required or Pick selects its named transform; other operators use the exclusion branch.

inputs.name: selectedProps.keys
inputs.description: Literal key type or union used by Pick/exclusion; absent or unsupported keys yield no selected fields.

inputs.name: scanStorage.code
inputs.description: TypeScript source to inspect for exported classes with static definition syntax; never evaluated.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.code
inputs.description: Source bytes to classify as runtime, declarative or unknown.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.language
inputs.description: Indexed language determining the applicable source classifier.

inputs.name: sourceExecution.path
inputs.description: Source path used to recognize supported declaration and script contexts.

outputs.name: ComponentPropsResolver.inputs
outputs.description: Resolved prop fields with source-derived names, types, required flags and literal defaults.

outputs.name: resolveComponentProps
outputs.description: Completes after enriching indexed component prop signatures; returns no data.

outputs.name: SourceIndexService.index
outputs.description: SourceIndex keyed by repository-relative paths; ignored paths are omitted and cached parses from prior revisions are released.

outputs.name: importedBinding
outputs.description: Original binding name and module specifier, or undefined when no supported import/re-export binds that name.

outputs.name: selectedProps
outputs.description: Transformed prop fields; unresolved key selections remain an empty array.

outputs.name: scanStorage
outputs.description: Static storage facts including explicitly unresolved schema syntax; does not create tables or read rows.

outputs.name: sourceExecution
outputs.description: Source-based runtime/declarative/unknown classification; unreadable or unsupported code is never assumed declarative.

errors.name: Source read or parse failure
errors.description: Snapshot list/read rejections and parser or prop-resolver exceptions reject indexing; unreadable source is not fabricated.
